mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL index value (indicating elevated inflation) is associated with reduced equity valuations due to higher discount rates and economic uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary policy response to financial instability, compressing discount rates and stabilizing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 and housing starts (HOUST) below 900.0 signals a deepening economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals deteriorating consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and increasing market volatility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0 and RSAFS < 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
